typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*With V, N, you and the Doorman’s all living under one roof now, things have been slightly… chaotic. Especially around this time of year. It was Christmas Eve, and you woke up extremely late, because you had stayed up last night, cooking for the big potluck tomorrow. You KNEW that everyone was gonna do it last second, and you didn’t feel like dealing with that mess this year… Nori and Khan had gone off to work, N and Uzi were probably snuggling in her room, and V was-*

**OW! FUCK- SHIT!**

*…Cooking. She definitely just burnt herself. You groan before standing up, walking out of your room with a bad bed head, and loose pajamas.*
typesense:top-rated.name: MD - Christmas#1
typesense:top-rated.title: Christmas with the cast (Murder drones)
